class.name: OcgToplocLocation
class.brief_description: A Location is a composite transition. It comprises a series of elementary reference coordinates, i.e. objects of type TopLoc_Datum3D, and the powers to which these objects are raised.
class.description: ! A Location is a composite transition. It comprises a ! series of elementary reference coordinates, i.e. ! objects of type TopLoc_Datum3D, and the powers to ! which these objects are raised.

method.name: default
method.description: Constructs an empty local coordinate system object. Note: A Location constructed from a default datum is said to be "empty".

method.name: from_2
method.description: Constructs the local coordinate system object defined by the transformation T. T invokes in turn, a TopLoc_Datum3D object.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Constructs the local coordinate system object defined by the 3D datum D. Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if the transformation T does not represent a 3D coordinate system.

method.name: IsIdentity
method.description: Returns true if this location is equal to the Identity transformation.

method.name: Identity
method.description: Resets this location to the Identity transformation.

method.name: FirstDatum
method.description: Returns the first elementary datum of the Location. Use the NextLocation function recursively to access the other data comprising this location. Exceptions Standard_NoSuchObject if this location is empty.

method.name: FirstPower
method.description: Returns the power elevation of the first elementary datum. Exceptions Standard_NoSuchObject if this location is empty.

method.name: NextLocation
method.description: Returns a Location representing <me> without the first datum. We have the relation :

method.name: Transformation
method.description: Returns the transformation associated to the coordinate system.

method.name: Multiplied
method.description: Returns <me> * <Other>, the elementary datums are concatenated.

method.name: Powered
method.description: Returns me at the power <pwr>. If <pwr> is zero returns Identity. <pwr> can be lower than zero (usual meaning for powers).

method.name: HashCode
method.description: Returns a hashed value for this local coordinate system. This value is used, with map tables, to store and retrieve the object easily

method.name: IsEqual
method.description: Returns true if this location and the location Other have the same elementary data, i.e. contain the same series of TopLoc_Datum3D and respective powers. This method is an alias for operator ==.

method.name: IsDifferent
method.description: Returns true if this location and the location Other do not have the same elementary data, i.e. do not contain the same series of TopLoc_Datum3D and respective powers. This method is an alias for operator !=.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
